expects.rule: The home page says who the person is in one or two sentences and links to what they have made or written; a short bio and a link to a résumé are the common pattern.
A skip link or equivalent lets keyboard users bypass the repeated header (WCAG 2.4.1, level A).
Text can be enlarged to 200% without loss of content or function (WCAG 1.4.4, level AA).
Content reflows to a 320 CSS pixel width without scrolling in two directions (WCAG 1.4.10, level AA).
Writing is subscribable: an RSS or Atom feed link is shown, as listed on personalsit.es for most entries.
Pages carry a date or an updated mark so readers can judge how current a post or a CV is.
Contact is a plain email or profile link; the CV is available as a web page and not only as a file download.

traits: 4 of 7 use one typeface family (Bobby Hiltz a system font, llimllib notes Georgia, Melike Turgut Agrandir, Mathias Adolfsson Inter); the other 3 pair a display or slab face with a text face.

5 of 7 are text first, with no image or one image on the first screen (Lynn Fisher, Ben Myers, Bobby Hiltz, Hazel Weakly, llimllib notes); Melike Turgut and Mathias Adolfsson lead with graphics or work.
5 of 7 are on a light background (#e4e2d7, #fff, #f3e7eb, #fffff8, #eaece5) and 2 of 7 on a dark one (#2c0943, #080808).
3 of 7 set the name in very large type (Lynn Fisher 96 px, Hazel Weakly 172 px, Ben Myers 56 px); Bobby Hiltz uses a 36 px heading.
Navigation is three to six links on 4 of 7 (Lynn Fisher six, Ben Myers six plus a Menu, Bobby Hiltz three, Hazel Weakly four plus four); Mathias Adolfsson has one link.
3 of 7 show a theme or settings control on the first screen (Lynn Fisher, Hazel Weakly, Ben Myers' Menu), and 2 of 7 show RSS (Lynn Fisher, llimllib notes).
Personality sits in small details: a version mark, a webring badge, an 88x31 button, glossy icons in the title, a command-K search.
7 of 7 show no cookie banner or newsletter popup on the first screen.

sites.name: Lynn Fisher
sites.why: Paper-textured beige (#e4e2d7) page with no image: a 96 px two-line name in a decorative display face (Hubano Rough), tagline in Sydonia, six links as a contents list with dot leaders and roman numerals (About to Gifs, RSS among them), a version mark v. XIX and a sun icon for the theme.
sites.recognition: Website Design Awards, Site of the Day, 2025-07-19 (overall 9.0/10)

sites.name: Ben Myers

sites.name: Melike Turgut
sites.why: Pale grey-green (#eaece5) screen with the words 'me' and 'like' in olive Agrandir spread across the full width and eight glossy 3D icons between them. Name, role and city at the top corners, a three-line intro at bottom left and Email, LinkedIn and X at bottom right. Eight story chapters follow.

sites.name: Mathias Adolfsson
sites.why: Near-black (#080808) screen: name and 'Independent Creative Engineer' top-left, About top-right in 12 px Inter, and a curved carousel of client site screens (Tentipi centred, Bonza and Mikuta at the edges) with the client name under it. Little text; the work is the page.

avoid: A hero with a gradient, a headshot in a circle and 'Hi, I'm ... a full-stack developer' repeated from template themes.
Skill percentage bars and technology logo grids in place of describing what was made.
A résumé that exists only as a PDF download.
A newsletter popup or cookie banner covering a page with no tracking.
A theme switch that resets on every page or ignores the system preference.
No dates on posts or projects.
A contact form with no email fallback.
